limitations: No current-sharing, temperature, EMI, capacitor ripple or fault-survival test performed.
Graph is a trace-assistance model: no filled-zone edges, no arc paths; pad spreading/solder resistance ignored. Native DRC remains connectivity authority.
A path passing through a shared trunk and a1A branch cannot be assigned one current indiscriminately. Reported1A candidate loss is only a comparison screen.
Area numbers count saved filled polygons, not thermally effective independent copper or actual fabricated copper.
No source, motor, enclosure, assembly or manufacturing compatibility approval is made.
